correctness.rationale: For a>=2, w_a(r)=r+a min_{ell>=0}(ell+lambda(r+ell a)), lambda shortest number of positive triangular summands; Gauss gives lambda<=3, ell>=2 cannot strictly improve, and ell=1 improves to 2 only when r+a triangular. Hence exact h=1/2/3 layer criteria. Standard Apéry genus formula and conductor=max(w)-a+1 give conductor=3a iff h(a−1)=3, exactly the two stated exceptional tests. Landau–Ramanujan bounds two-triangular representability by O(a/sqrt log a), while the r+a triangular count is O(sqrt a), proving g,c=3a+O(a/sqrt log a) and density-one exact 3a conductor. Independent Dijkstra residue shortest-path comparisons verify small/medium a; the arithmetic asymptotic depends on the cited classical theorems, not enumeration.
